report.title: RhoeLiquid Rendering Lab Report
report.author: Example Systems Group
report.purpose: Demonstrate that the same Liquid template engine can emit LaTeX artifacts from structured JSON data.

protocol: Define a small measurement context as JSON.
Render a LaTeX template through the `liquid` CLI.
Compile the generated `.tex` file with a LaTeX toolchain if desired.

interpretation.label: Signal
interpretation.text: All samples rendered through the same template without document-type-specific code.

interpretation.label: Next step
interpretation.text: Use a dedicated escaping policy before rendering untrusted content into LaTeX.
